All 4 must-fire cases fired and all 4 must-not-fire cases stayed silent, on every one of
the 3 runs — `stability` is 1.0 for each case, so the gate `at_least(2)` is met with
margin on all 8 and `coverage_threshold: 1.0` is satisfied.

`n_discrimination: 0` is reported because the corpus declares no discrimination pairs;
the spec does not use that dimension.

The red proof holds: `NETMECH-F1`, reconstructed from the landed outcome of
`2041-75d6-2a2f-4be9` (the `env_var` `REBAR_LLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL` admitted by the marker at
`src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py:152`, absent from `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`, no
retirement recorded), is caught by this criterion on every run. That is a change the
existing shrink-only ratchet passed.
